verdict.rationale: RUN ships AI features (AI-enabled error flagging, an AI virtual assistant, AI timesheet import), so whether customer data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no statement about AI training data use, opt-outs, or data-usage controls. The OAuth access controls in API Central are an adjacent security feature, not a training opt-out, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
